seed.name: Caddy HTTP module layout
seed.text: HTTP server and handler infrastructure lives in modules/caddyhttp. Concrete HTTP modules occupy subdirectories. Read the implementation and existing package tests before changing behavior.

seed.name: Restic package layout
seed.text: Command-line entry points live in cmd/restic. Repository operations live in internal/repository; storage implementations live in internal/backend. These layers have package-local tests. Check source and tests rather than assuming a command directly implements its storage operations.

seed.name: Rclone package layout
seed.text: Shared filesystem interfaces and operations live under fs. Storage-specific implementations live under backend, commands under cmd, and supporting libraries under lib. Use the relevant package tests to check behavior; a backend implementation is not the only place that coordinates transfers.
